rv.q: Oliver Twist at Hull Truck is far from a disappointment. It's a solid, respectable production with moments of real heart...
Dark Dickensian drama wrapped in the glow of Christmas spirit from writer Deborah McAndrew and composer John Biddle

Alternating the role of Oliver, tonight's William Poyser-Alton is a picture of innocence. Playing into a nervous stutter, Poyser-Alton has great reactionary skills and does well with the material. A brash and frenetic Fagin from Polly Lister bundles onto the stage with a larger-than-life energy.
